text:
Swiggy, Zepto and Rapido all had US-rooted VCs on their cap tables early. Bessemer was an early Swiggy investor, and Nexus backed Zepto and Rapido.

Many big US funds now run India teams or India funds, and some of them write first cheques here. In this carousel: 8 US and US-India investors active in India, from Together Fund and Nexus Venture Partners at the early end to Insight Partners, General Atlantic and WestBridge Capital at growth stage. For each you get the stage, cheque size where it is public, sectors and Indian portfolio companies.

Quick tip: match the fund to your stage. Nexus, Together Fund and Bessemer's India team invest early, while Insight, General Atlantic and WestBridge usually come in once you have real scale. A warm intro from a founder they have backed works far better than a cold email to the US office.

text:
Indian startups raised about $1.3 billion in venture debt in 2025, according to Stride Ventures' latest private debt report. Swiggy, Zepto and Meesho have all used it alongside equity.

Debt will not replace your equity round, but it can stretch your runway without giving away more of your company. In this carousel: 8 venture debt and revenue-based financing providers in India, from GetVantage, Velocity and Recur Club for revenue-stage brands to Stride, Trifecta, Alteria and InnoVen for VC-backed startups. You get ticket sizes where public, sectors and companies they have funded.

Quick tip: revenue-based financing is usually for steady revenue with short payback, like inventory or ads. Venture debt is easiest to raise right after an equity round, when lenders can lean on your new investors. Always check the total cost, warrants and covenants, not only the interest rate.
